title: Database backups from the admin
notes: A new Admin → Backups page lets you back up and download your database, restore from a backup (a safety snapshot is always taken first), and schedule automatic daily/weekly backups with retention. Point Convoro at an S3 bucket to also mirror backups offsite. Category icons were simplified to just the Font Awesome class field.

changelog.text: Admin → Backups: one-click backup + download, guarded restore with an automatic pre-restore safety snapshot, and scheduled daily/weekly backups with retention.
Optional offsite backups to an S3-compatible bucket.
Category icons simplified to the Font Awesome class field (preset picker removed).
